sources.entry: everythingByMdfind - Fast file search using Spotlight. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/appledragon/everythingByMdfind) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS file search GUI that uses the native Spotlight index (mdfind) to find files by name or content, with previews, filters, batch operations and disk space analysis.
summary.what_it_does: Searches files on macOS through the Spotlight index, matching by file name or content. Results can be filtered by size range, extension, case sensitivity and full or partial match, and limited to a chosen directory. A preview panel shows text (with encoding detection), images (including animated GIF), SVG, video and audio, with a built-in media player. A disk space analysis feature draws a bar chart of the largest subfolders for a directory, including the home directory. Results can be sorted and exported to JSON, Excel, HTML, Markdown or CSV, and files can be multi-selected for batch open, delete, copy, move or rename. The interface supports multiple search tabs and six themes.
use_cases: Find files on a Mac by name or content quickly
Locate large files and old downloads taking up disk space
Analyze which folders use the most disk space
Preview images, videos or documents before opening them
Batch rename, move or delete search results
Export a file listing to a spreadsheet or CSV
notable: Uses the native macOS Spotlight index for fast searches
Built-in disk space analyzer with drill-down bar charts
Multi-tab search interface with independent results per tab
Preview for text, images, SVG, video and audio inside the app
Export results to JSON, Excel, HTML, Markdown or CSV
caveats: Designed for macOS only, since it relies on Spotlight
Requires Python 3.6+ and PyQt6 when run from source
Pre-built app is provided as a .dmg on GitHub Releases
